name: BTC perp 200d-gated long (TG1x) / vol-targeted variant (VT_TG)

position.VT_TG: w(t+1) = min(2.0, vol_scale(t) * gate(t))  [cap binds first: never > 2x]
position.rebalance: daily at 00:00 UTC (trade at close of day t = open of day t+1)

costs_funding.taker_fee: 5bp per side on |change in notional weight| (incl. drift rebalance)
costs_funding.funding: w * sum(8h funding rates that day); long pays when positive, receives when negative
costs_funding.expected_funding_drag: TG1x: only in-market ~50-60% of days; drag = avg_w * ann funding (~5.7%/yr OOS for VT_TG, ~similar for TG1x when in-market)

no_other_overlays: funding tilt and taker-flow overlay tested and REJECTED (see qr_funding_*, qr_taker_*)
